records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales increased 31% domestically and 4% internationally, and sales to customers outside the U.S. were approximately 48% of total sales in the second quarter of 2022 compared to 54% during the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the six months ended June 30, 2022, the Company achieved record sales driven by robust demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Excluding these impacts, accounts receivable increased $47.7 million as a result of higher volume; inventories increased $62.4 million to support production amid supply chain difficulties; and trade accounts payable increased $23.7 million due to higher inventory purchases.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Operating margin of 23.4% was up 30 basis points.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Adjusted operating income increased 14% to $189.8 million.
